caption: A 320-character message splits into 153 + 153 + 14 characters, so three parts are billed at ₹0.20 each for ₹0.60. The return arrows are the sent and delivered callbacks; the recipient joins the parts.

spec.title: SMS send path
spec.aria: A sequence diagram shows the app calling divideMessage on a 320-character message, sending three parts of 153, 153 and 14 characters through SmsManager to the carrier; the carrier bills ₹0.60, delivers the parts to the recipient, receives an acknowledgement, and returns sent and delivered callbacks to the app.
